column3: So you can come and go as you please even with the isle in motion? I know not how this golden path of yours works, but it's certainly convenient.
For want of things to do, I occasionally stand watch like so...
But there's nothing but clouds, thick and endless. I haven't caught so much as a sliver of the surface.
Mayhap Visna can craft...<pant>...a training dummy...
So that's a realmship. Not quite like Azys Lla as I had imagined, but it's impressive in size.
For good or ill, the voyage has been uneventful, but I made sure to keep my skills honed. I stand ready for whatever awaits.
